content.text: can I use clanker to order from swiggy?
I’m using your `$i-have-adhd` style and checking Clanker’s current ordering and payment support.

**You can try, but Clanker hasn’t completed a verified Swiggy order yet.**

Its phone/SMS login and card-payment flows are implemented, but tested only with dummy sites. Real Swiggy login and checkout still need verification. See the [login status](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/docs/decisions/2026-10-06-phone-sms-login.md).

Swiggy also offers an [official integration for AI agents](https://mcp.swiggy.com/builders/docs/start/what-is-swiggy-mcp/) that supports ordering. Clanker isn’t connected to it currently.

For a first trial, ask Clanker:

> Find chicken biryani on Swiggy under ₹400 including fees, prepare the cart, and show me the total before placing the order.
